title: A command that runs one job per source must not stop at the first failed source
rule: When an adapter (CLI, MCP tool, UI action) loops over several sources, folders or faces and runs one job each (scan, export, activate), a failure of one job must become that item's result (a row with an `error` field), not a `?` that leaves the loop. Run the rest, return every result, and exit or report non-zero from the first failure at the end. Match the core's own batch behavior (CoreApi scan-all logs a failed source and goes on). Test it with a first item that fails (a folder removed before the run) and assert the later items still ran.
rationale: E26.2 (#165): `fm scan` without a folder used `?` on each source's scan, so one unplugged folder stopped every later source from being scanned and dropped the counts already collected.
